priorPreGateEvidence.reason: The one-control V1 check was comparable, but the 3x3 stopped before nine pairs: a later V1 control had Agent Reach unknown discovery failure and Groq 429 with Retry-After 6s and remainingTokens 5395. Exa logged 200 responses; an overlong highlight or other field is a plausible normalization failure, not a confirmed cause. The startup flag was cleared and a clean deploy is live.
